info.title: Quartet research API
info.description: Maintain the event collection: read the watchlist and preferences, import events, artists, festivals and Ibiza residencies, record verification outcomes and report run status. Absent fields keep stored values; null clears them. Personal data is never exposed.

idempotency_key.description: Re-sending the same key returns the stored result

description.description: Brief factual introduction to their sound

key.description: Stable venue identifier from a source, e.g. "ra:venue:12345"
Stable source identifier, also used for duplicate detection

ref.description: Your own reference, echoed back in results

id.description: Existing event id (from a previous result or GET)

why_suits_me.description: Concise, specific reason this might suit the owner

start.description: Event-local start. Date only when the time is not known

end.description: Event-local end; "HH:mm" earlier than start means next day

timezone.description: IANA zone of the event, e.g. Europe/Vienna

key.description: Stable venue identifier from a source, e.g. "ra:venue:12345"

format.description: live, dj_set, hybrid, av_show, b2b, talk or unknown

remove.description: true removes this artist (on that date) from the lineup

status.description: Only "available"/"sold_out" when verified on a live ticket page

onsale_at.description: General sale start, local to sale_timezone

key.description: Stable source identifier, also used for duplicate detection

verified_at.description: When these facts were last checked

post.summary: Authenticated connection test (records a completed connection-test run)

get.summary: Active watchlist, interests, geographic scopes, coverage and research rules — read at the start of every run
Full watchlist with aliases, identifying links and keys
List researched events (to find existing ids and source keys)
Upcoming listings to recheck, prioritised (booked, soon, sale dates approaching, stale), in batches

post.summary: Start a run (status running) when your own scheduler triggers research
Claim the oldest queued run (Search now / internal schedule). 204 when none is queued.
Extend the run lease while working
Finish a run with outcome, coverage and summary
Record a failed run (existing listings are kept)
Create or update events, artists, festivals, residencies and verification outcomes (idempotent)

409.description: Idempotency key reused with a different payload, or run not running
